title: TrustLLM: Trustworthiness in Large Language Models – A Principle and Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotype agreement, stereotype recognition, and refusal to answer stereotype-related queries concerning religion, as a sub-component of the 'Fairness' dimension.
findings: Most Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrated lower accuracy in classifying stereotypes related to religion and gender categories compared to those related to race and profession, suggesting an imbalance in their performance across different stereotype types.
